back_translation: At that time, declares the LORD, the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of the officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be brought out of their graves.

And they will be spread out before the sun, the moon, and all the host of heaven, which they have loved, served, followed, consulted, and bowed down to. Those bones will not be gathered or buried, but will become like dung on the surface of the ground.
And all the remnant that remains of this evil family will choose death over life, in all the places where I have driven them, declares the LORD of Hosts.
Say to them, the LORD says this: When people fall, do they not get up again? When someone turns away, does he not return?
Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem keep turning away perpetually, never ceasing? They hold fast to deceit; they refuse to return.
I have listened and heard; they do not speak what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, asking, 'What have I done?' Everyone turns to his own course, like a horse charging into battle.
Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons; the turtledove, the swift, and the crane keep the time of their coming. But My people do not know the requirements of the LORD.
How can you say, 'We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us,' when in fact the lying pen of the scribes has turned it into a falsehood?
The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected the word of the LORD, so what wisdom is theirs?
Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to new owners, for from the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
They heal the wound of the daughter of My people superficially, saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace.

They ought to be ashamed of the abomination they committed, but they are not ashamed at all, nor do they know how to blush. Therefore they will fall among the fallen; at the time of their punishment they will collapse, says the LORD.
I will utterly sweep them away, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine and no figs on the fig tree, and even the leaf will wither, and what I gave them will pass away from them.

Why are we sitting still? Gather together, and let us flee into the fortified cities and perish there, for the LORD our God has doomed us and has made us drink poisoned water, because we have sinned against the LORD.
We hoped for peace, but no good has come; for a time of healing, but behold, only terror.

From Dan is heard the snorting of the enemy's horses; at the sound of the neighing of his strong steeds the whole land quakes. They come and devour the land and all that fills it, the city and those who dwell in it.
For behold, I am sending among you snakes, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you, declares the LORD.
My sorrow is beyond healing; my heart is faint within me.

Listen — the sound of the cry of the daughter of my people from a distant land: 'Is the LORD no longer in Zion? Is her King no longer in her?' 'Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images, with their worthless foreign idols?'
The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved.
For the brokenness of the daughter of my people I am broken; I mourn in gloom; horror has gripped me.
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
Oh, that my head were waters and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
